title: O'Romeo
desc: Amidst post-independence Mumbai's transformation, the underworld emerges, unveiling a bygone criminal landscape that threads through the shadowy streets of India's vibrant metropolis.

title: Bruce Lee - The Fighter
desc: Kartik sacrifices his studies for his sister and becomes a stuntman. But he ends up helping a cop to unearth the evil designs of Deepak.

title: Gadar: Ek Prem Katha
desc: During Partition, Tara and Sakina marry and enjoy a happy life together. However, Sakina's father forces her to remain in Pakistan, tearing the couple apart.

title: Kalki 2898 AD
desc: In a post-apocalyptic world, a group of people set out to save a woman pregnant with Lord Vishnu's 10th and final avatar, Kalki, from an evil supreme god-king, Yaskin.

title: Maaveeran
desc: After an accident, timid cartoonist Sathya begins to hear the voice of Maaveeran, a comic character he has created. Guided by Maaveeran, he takes a stand against a group of evil men.

title: Good Newwz
desc: Two married couples are unsuccessful in conceiving and seek medical treatment. However, they end up in a complicated situation after their doctor makes a blunder.

title: RA. One
desc: Hell breaks loose when Ra.One, the powerful antagonist of a video game, takes a physical form and attempts to destroy Shekhar's, the video game designer's, family.

title: Batti Gul Meter Chalu
desc: Interlinked in a love triangle, three childhood friends tumble into a courtroom drama when a printing press owned by one of them receives an inflated electricity bill.

title: A Flying Jatt
desc: Aman who is scared of heights, discovers his superpowers when he is forced to face the evil Raka, who is sent by an industrialist to destroy humanity.

title: Mr. & Mrs. Khiladi
desc: When stars misalign, love blossoms between an astrology-obsessed idler and a headstrong fish heiress whose father will settle for nothing less than a hardworking son-in-law.

title: Chori Chori Chupke Chupke
desc: Raj and Priya, a married couple, hire Madhubala, a prostitute, as the surrogate mother of their child. Trouble brews when Madhubala falls in love with Raj and insists on keeping the child.

title: The Greatest of All Time
desc: After a tragedy tears him apart from his wife, Gandhi, a former elite spy, is forced back into the field for a mission of the utmost importance.

title: Dream Girl
desc: A man lands a call center job by mimicking a woman's voice, gaining fame and a loyal fan base. However, his double life spirals out of control when rabid clients overstep boundaries.

title: Assi
desc: A vigilante named Chattri Man executes violent offenders to aid an abused educator. Consequently, an advocate debates justice versus retribution.
